title: Audit Ingest Priority Governor — RBAC V2 & SSO Event Quality Controls
creator: Ava Patel
description: Design and implement an adaptive ingress governor for audit events that applies priority bucketing, tenant-aware backpressure, and selective indexing to control storage and compute costs while preserving high-fidelity records for security-sensitive events (RBAC v2 changes, SSO/SAML admin flows, and super-admin operations). This ticket covers schema for priority tags, the token-bucket / leaky-bucket quota algorithm per-tenant, an inexpensive pre-ingest classifier for event importance, and the default spillover policy to cold index or sampled journal. The goal is to avoid unbounded index growth from noisy tenants or large automated churn while ensuring high-importance security events are always indexed synchronously.
decision_log: 2026-02-18: Chose a dual-bucket model: 'critical' (always sync-index) and 'economy' (eligible for sampling/cold-spill). Rationale: simple semantics for reviewers and deterministic guarantees for security team.

2026-02-22: Use per-tenant token-bucket with burst allowance + global soft-cap to avoid flash storms. Trade-off: slightly higher tail latency for non-critical events under pressure but bounded storage cost.
2026-03-02: Opted for pre-ingest lightweight classifier (rule-based with small ML fallback) to avoid added latency on fast paths. ML flagged for later A/B if precision/recall is insufficient.
2026-03-05: Keep schema mutation events (RBAC policy changes) in critical bucket by default; allow opt-in overrides via admin console for enterprise customers.
2026-03-08: Rollout plan agreed: feature-flagged canary -> 5% tenants -> 25% -> 100% over 3 weeks, with automatic rollback on error-rate or storage-surge thresholds.
tasks: Add 'priority' enum to audit event schema and update producers (auth-service, sso-service, admin-api)
Implement token-bucket controller in ingestion proxy (chronicle-proxy module)
Expose metrics: per-tenant ingress_rate, bucket_fill, sampled_count, spill_count, sync_index_latency
Create cold-index pipeline for economy spills and sampled journal storage format
Dashboard: per-tenant cost estimate, top noisy tenants, and SLO dashboard for critical event indexing
E2E tests and chaos tests to validate backpressure and producer retry behavior
acceptance_criteria: Priority tag added to audit event schema and producers updated (auth-service PR linked)
Ingress governor deployed behind feature flag; canaryed at 5% with zero loss of critical events
Under high synthetic load (2x peak), storage growth rate reduced by >= 30% compared to baseline through sampling/spill policies
Critical event end-to-end index latency remains within SLA (p50 < 150ms, p95 < 400ms)
Dashboards show per-tenant cost delta and spill metrics; automated alert triggers on unexpected spill spikes
Security review completed and signoff captured in Confluence
